title: Acha Baba Ja Rahe Ho
body:
Alwida Baba Alwida Baba Alwida Baba
Akhira Rukhsat ko aye jab Shah e Karb o bala.
Jor kay hatoun ko Sughra s.a ny Yh Baba sy kaha.
Acha baba ja rahe ho jao Bus itna Karo..
Pass Ashger s.a Ko mery lekin Khudara Chor do.
01. Sakht Garmi ka Safar hy or yeh Nani se Jan
Phool sa Asghar a.s mera Murjha na jaye baba Jan
ap kay hujray mea Jannat ke hawa ka hai Guzar
main wahen sounge baba isko lay kar Raat ko... hayee.....
<<MINI>>
acha baba ja rahe ho......
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Mea Bina Akbar a.s kay Jee Na Paounge Baba Magar, Dil behal jaye ga Ashger ko Humakta dekh kr, Yeh Bahra Ghar hoga weeran tu Marjounge mea, Zinda rehne ka mere koi bahana bhi tu ho..
<<MINI>>
hayeeee
Acha baba ja rahe ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Sath Apny Loriyan day kr Sunlounge issay.
Syeda s.a ke mea Kahani khud Sunaounge isay.
Dekh kr Asghar a.s ka Chehra Chain aye ga Mujhy.
is kay chehray mea Shabahat aap ki aati hai joo..
<<MINI>>
Hayeee
Acha baba.....
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Hath Mere sir pay rakh ke Kon day ga Ab dua, tum na ho gay Baba na Akbar na Abid Chacha, jarahi hain maa behan phuphyan sabhe muh mor kay, mea bharay Ghar ke hun Addii
kia kroun baba kahooo...
<<MINI>>
hayeee
acha baba..
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Baba akber sy mea kehti he rahi kab aogay, Sir jukhaye wo khara tha ashk ankhoun mea leyh, Yaad Jab Wada Dilaya Ro ke wo kehne laga, Jald aaunga behan mein Dum Raha seene mein tu...
<<MINI>>
Hayee
Acha baba ja rahe ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Jald bulwana Mery baba Madinay se mujhe, Bhai ka sehra banounge mea apny hath sy, husn mere bhaiyon ka Dekhega sara jahan, Dulha jab Akber a.s sa ho, asghar as sa Sehbala  bhi ho.
<<MINI>>
hayeee
Acha baba ja rahe ho..
<<DIVIDER>>
07. Muskurata hai mera Asghar as Sakina as ke tarhan, wo Chali jayegi tu kaise jaungi main bhala, Yad aye ge sakina a.s ke tu dekhungi issay, Dil sukoon paye ga kesay Ghar mea jab koi na hoo,,, Hayeee
<<MINI>>
Acha baba ja rahe ho....
<<DIVIDER>>
08. Halq ko asghar a.s kay baba Chomtay ho Jab kabhi, yun tarap jatay ho jesay Zakham dekha ho koi, Muskurata hai jo Asghar ro diya karte ho tum, muskurane mein Chupa hai Raaz kia is k Kaho...
<<MINI>>
hayeee
Acha baba..
<<DIVIDER>>
09. Jab Samar aye harum dekha Raza Sughra a.s ny kia, Maa ki Godi mein nahi Asghar hy kurta Khoon Bhara, Lakriyan Jholay ke seenay say lagaye han Rubab as, Keh rahay han Roo kay Abid a.s Dhoop sy ammaa a.s uthoo.......
